Review_Text: The app has been down since Sunday. So frustrating, I cannot pay anyone.
My payroll batch failed in the outage. Terrible day for my business.
Cannot check my balance before the outage notice even appeared. Angry.
Contact centre queue was 40 minutes during the outage. Disgusting.
The branch was packed with angry customers during the app outage.
Day three of the app not loading. The worst week, absolutely terrible.
Consultants set up paper withdrawals for everyone. Great recovery effort.
A supervisor called me back to fix my merchant payments. Impressed.
App is back and my transfers went through. Excellent recovery.
Backlog of payments cleared overnight. Great work by the bank.
Got a phishing SMS pretending to be the bank. Scary and sneaky.
Nearly fell for a fake bank WhatsApp. These scammers are terrible.
The in-app fraud warnings are clear and helpful. Love that.
Skimming device found at our local ATM. I am so angry, feel completely unsafe there.
The bank froze my card after a suspicious R8,000 charge. Great security, so happy.
Someone tried to log in as me and the app blocked them. Great security.
Reported a scam number through WhatsApp banking. Quick response, impressed.
Black Friday payment failed twice. Very annoying at midnight.
Black Friday checkout through the app was seamless. Excellent.
My supplier payment was delayed on the busiest weekend. Disappointed.
Branch was calm and quick after the online rush. Friendly tellers.
ATM limits dropped my cash withdrawal on payday. Terrible timing.
Stokvel payout day and the app struggled all morning. Frustrating.
Waited 20 minutes to dispute a Black Friday double charge. Annoying.
Refund from an online store reflected the same day. Great.
Black Friday sale purchase went through instantly at midnight. Brilliant.
My transfer to family for December took two days. Not happy.
Consultant helped me set up account alerts. Friendly, patient and excellent.
Cash deposit for the shop counted wrong by R50. Disappointed.
The app kept me informed through the whole outage week. Impressed.
WhatsApp banking never skipped a beat during the outage. Fantastic.
Business banking desk sorted my POS machine issue same day. Excellent.
Used the campus ATM for my allowance withdrawal. No problems.
My grandchild's transfer took three days during the backlog. Frustrating.
The call centre agent was rude about my phishing report. Disgusted.
App stability since the outage has been perfect. Great to see.
Opened a December savings plan with good advice. Helpful consultant.
Drew December grocery money at the mall ATM.
Client payments all landed on time this week. Smooth sailing.
Checked my shop balance on WhatsApp during the outage week.
